diagnosticCases.name: unclassified publishable workspace
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_PACKAGE_UNCLASSIFIED] packages/unclassified/package.json (@fixture/unclassified): publishable manifest has no product-catalog or RELEASE_PACKAGE_POLICY row. Remediation: add one matching catalog and release-policy row, or mark the workspace private.

diagnosticCases.name: duplicate release-group membership
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_GROUP_DUPLICATE] adapter (@fixture/adapter): RELEASE_PACKAGE_POLICY assigns both core and integration. Remediation: classify each publishable package in exactly one release group.

diagnosticCases.name: stale policy package
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_POLICY_STALE] ghost: RELEASE_PACKAGE_POLICY names no product-catalog package or public manifest. Remediation: delete the stale policy row or admit the real package atomically.

diagnosticCases.name: lockstep core version drift
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_CORE_VERSION_DRIFT] core-b (@fixture/core-b): core manifest version 1.0.0-alpha.5 disagrees with core-a at 1.0.0-alpha.4. Remediation: set every core manifest to one byte-identical version.

diagnosticCases.name: invalid cross-unit internal range
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_INTERNAL_RANGE] adapter (@fixture/adapter) -> core-b: policy requires 1.0.0-alpha.4 but peerDependencies declares workspace:^. Remediation: declare peerDependencies.@fixture/core-b as 1.0.0-alpha.4 and retain workspace:^ only in devDependencies.

diagnosticCases.name: peer range below the tested floor
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_PEER_FLOOR] adapter (@fixture/adapter) peer ai: policy range ^7.0.93 has floor 7.0.93 but peerDependencies declares ^7.0.83. Remediation: set peerDependencies.ai to ^7.0.93 and prove exact ai@7.0.93 in a packed consumer.

diagnosticCases.name: workspace-only compatibility alias
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_PEER_ALIAS] adapter (@fixture/adapter): devDependencies.ai-unsupported-fixture aliases npm:ai@7.0.83 outside the declared ai policy. Remediation: remove the alias and install each exact tested ai version in an isolated consumer.

diagnosticCases.name: prerelease range admitting an untested version
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_PRERELEASE_RANGE] adapter (@fixture/adapter) -> core-b: range ^1.0.0-alpha.4 admits untested 1.0.0-alpha.5 while tested contains only 1.0.0-alpha.4. Remediation: use 1.0.0-alpha.4 until another exact prerelease passes, then list an explicit union.

diagnosticCases.name: packed import absent from the manifest
diagnosticCases.expected: [RELEASE_UNDECLARED_DEPENDENCY] adapter (@fixture/adapter): packed export imports fixture-undeclared but no dependency or peer is declared. Remediation: declare the runtime dependency in the manifest and release policy, or remove the import.
